schemaVersion.description: Contract version MAJOR.MINOR. A v1 consumer accepts any 1.x message.

identifier.description: Lowercase, MQTT-topic-safe identifier. Must equal the corresponding topic segment.

bootId.description: Random identifier generated by the gateway at every boot. Together with `sequence` it makes each message unique.

sequence.description: Per-boot message counter (uint32), incremented for every message the gateway produces, including buffered ones.

timestampOrNull.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit offset (UTC 'Z' recommended), or null when the producer has no trustworthy clock value.

measured_at.description: Time the BMS took the measurement. The Libre Solar ThingSet live report carries no timestamp, so this is null unless a future firmware supplies one.

gateway_received_at.description: Gateway clock when the ThingSet report was received over UART (null before NTP/GSM time sync).

published_at.description: Gateway clock when the MQTT message was (re)published.

thingsetGenericValue.description: Value of a ThingSet object without a dedicated schema entry. Preserved as received.
